sources.title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
evidence: Norsk Hydro (OTCMKTS: NHYDY) said on Monday it could take a financial hit of up to $210 million as it continues to buy gas at spot-market prices following disruptions to natural gas deliveries at its Alunorte refinery in Brazil.
The Norwegian company estimates a $75 million to $100 million impact to its bauxite and alumina business in the third quarter due to lower production and purchase of gas above contracted prices.
It expects a further $90 million to $110 million hit in the fourth quarter from gas arbitrage costs at Alunorte.
Hydro said gas supplier CELBA notified Alunorte in August that gas availability had been disrupted.
The refinery, in Brazil's northern state of Para, had cut output to 50% of capacity earlier that month due to disruptions.
Alunorte had begun ramping up alumina production to full capacity after reaching a temporary agreement with CELBA in August.
Alunorte does not expect further supply interruptions stemming from the current situation, and is working closely with CELBA, Hydro said.

sources.title: 호주, 한국산 후판 반덤핑 관세 부과 확정
evidence: 한국무역협회에 따르면 호주 정부는 지난 9월 24일 한국과 중국에서 수출되는 일정 규격의 후판에 대한 반덤핑 관세 부과를 확정했다.
호주 정부는 "일부 수입 후판의 덤핑으로 자국 산업에 판매 감소와 가격 하락 등 실질적인 피해가 발생했다"고 판단했다.
대상은 두께 4.75mm 이상, 폭 600mm 이상의 비합금강 또는 기타 합금강 후판이다.
코일 형태가 아니면서 금속 피복·도금·코팅되지 않은 제품이 포함된다.

sources.title: INSIGHT: Brazil court ruling threatens Braskem Idesa's bankruptcy exit
evidence: A court injunction in Brazil could prevent Braskem Idesa from securing all of the $486 million its majority shareholder would provide for its emergence from bankruptcy protection.
Braskem disagrees with the ruling and intends to appeal it, the company said in court documents.
Otherwise, Braskem Idesa may need to find replacement funds. If that happens, Braskem's stake in the joint venture could be diluted.
The roll-up of $131 million in prepetition financing.
$283 million in debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing.
$71 million in equity contributions to be made on Braskem Idesa's emergence from bankruptcy protection.
At the least, the order bars Braskem from contributing the $71 million that the joint venture would receive when it exits bankruptcy protection.

Altogether, Braskem would hold a 58 1/3% stake in the reorganized Braskem Idesa. Holders of senior secured notes would see their holdings converted into a 33 1/3% stake in the reorganized company. The remaining 8 1/3% stake would go to Grupo Idesa, the other legacy joint venture partner.

sources.title: Phasedown of Hydrofluorocarbons: Notice of 2027 Allowance Allocations for Production and Consumption of Regulated Substances Under the American Innovation and Manufacturing Act of 2020, and Notice of Final Actions Establishing Administrative Consequences
evidence: Under the phasedown schedule, for 2027, total production allowances may not exceed 229,521,263 metric tons of exchange value equivalent (MTEVe) and total consumption allowances may not exceed 181,522,990 MTEVe.
The EPA has set aside 1,000,000 MTEVe allowances for that purpose from both the consumption and production pools.

These entities failed to submit their auditing reports as required in 40 CFR 84.33 and therefore the EPA has withheld a portion of their allowances (if allowances were allocated to the entity) and will continue withholding these allowances until the missing reports are submitted and subsequently verified by the Agency: University of California (UC) San Diego and Wolfspeed.
